steps.title: Create an OAuth App in GitHub Settings
instructions: In the upper-right corner of any page on GitHub, click your profile picture, then click Settings.
In the left sidebar, click Developer settings, then OAuth apps.
Click New OAuth App (or Register a new application).
Type your application name, homepage URL, description, and callback URL.
Click Register application.

steps.title: Configure Callback URLs and Redirect Rules
instructions: Ensure your callback URL matches your application's redirect handler.
You can enter up to 10 callback URLs or enable wildcard matching if required.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
instructions: Copy the generated client ID.
Generate and copy the client secret and store it securely on your backend server.

steps.title: Send User to GitHub Authorization URL
instructions: Redirect your user to https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state, and optional PKCE parameters.
Prompt the user to sign in and authorize your application on GitHub.

steps.title: Exchange Code for Access Token
instructions: Receive the temporary code and state parameters at your redirect URI, verifying that state matches.
Send a POST request to https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token with client_id, client_secret, code, and redirect_uri, setting Accept: application/json.
Store the returned access_token securely.

steps.title: Verify Token with API Call
instructions: Send a GET request to https://api.github.com/user with header Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN.
Confirm a 200 OK response containing the authenticated user's profile details.

steps.title: Request Device and User Codes
instructions: Send a POST request to https://github.com/login/device/code with client_id and requested scopes.
Receive device_code, user_code, verification_uri, and interval.

steps.title: Prompt User to Authorize Device Code
instructions: Display user_code and direct the user to enter the code at https://github.com/login/device.

steps.title: Poll for Device Access Token
instructions: Poll POST https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token using client_id, device_code, and grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code at the specified interval.

steps.title: Authorize with PKCE Parameters
instructions: Generate a code verifier and compute its S256 code challenge. Include code_challenge and code_challenge_method=S256 in the authorize request.

steps.title: Exchange Code with Code Verifier
instructions: Exchange the authorization code and original code_verifier for an access token at POST https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token.

steps.title: Refresh Access Token Using Refresh Token
instructions: Send a POST request to https://github.com/login/oauth/access_token with grant_type=refresh_token, client_id, client_secret, and refresh_token.

steps.title: Request Organization Owner Approval for App Access
instructions: If organization OAuth app access restrictions are enabled, request organization owner approval for the OAuth app in organization settings.
